source_text: Ἡμεῖς δὲ καὶ εἱμαρμένης ἐσμὲν ἀνώτεροι, καὶ ἀντὶ πλανητῶν δαιμόνων ἕνα τὸν ἀπλανῆ δεσπότην μεμαθήκαμεν, καὶ οὐ καθ᾿ εἱμαρμένην ἀγόμενοι τοὺς ταύτης νομοθέτας παρῃτήμεθα.
thought_title: Above fate, under one unwandering Master
pass_a_gloss: But we are even higher than fate, and in place of wandering demons we have learned the one Master who does not wander, and not being led according to fate we have rejected its lawgivers.
pass_b_english: We, though, stand above fate itself. In place of wandering demons we have come to know one Master who never wanders; and because fate does not lead us, we have turned away the ones who made its laws.

choices.why: Tatian's pun: the planets ('wanderers') are demons; God is the fixed one
refusal of allegiance, not mere disagreement

notes: Context: Tatian has just attacked astrology (the zodiac as the demons' handiwork).
